title: How Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun Solved Pathfinding | War Stories | Ars Technica
summary: Westwood Studios co-founder Louis Castle talks about how pathfinding was solved in Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun, in an Ars Technica War Stories episode. It also touches on other challenges in Westwood's RTS games.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an accessible, non-technical look at real game pathfinding problems from a developer who built them.

quote.text: Ars Technica had a series of 10 minute videos where they interviewed developers about technical challenges.
